title: FileNode set: 'unsupported @type' error omits value and accepted set
description: crate-jmap-filenode-server/src/filenode.rs:697. The -16 rename turns every -14 client create ('directory', 'file', 'symlink') into invalidProperties 'unsupported @type'. The client cannot tell the case changed. Include the rejected value and the accepted names, e.g. format!("unsupported @type {s:?}; expected File, Directory, or SymLink"). This needs the description to be a String rather than &'static str in the consistency_error tuple.
close_reason: fixed in working tree (uncommitted), verified by adversarial reviewer + cargo test
